members.label: Behringer SY-1
members.differences: Behringer's copy of Pearl's two-channel drum synthesiser. It keeps the same two channels, each with eight faders, three switches and an OSC MODE knob, and adds a FINE tuning knob on each channel, TRIG buttons that fire a channel from the panel, and sockets on the top panel.

members.label: Pearl SY-1
members.differences: The original, Pearl's 1979 two-channel drum synthesiser, played from drum pads. Each channel has eight faders, three switches and an OSC MODE knob. The panel has a lamp for each channel that lights as it fires, and a POWER switch.
